arms.treatment: FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL at slots 0..95; identical no-transform protected replay at slots 96..383
arms.only_scientific_variable: supervision target at the 96 predeclared intervention slots

cohorts.development_evaluation: Existing E04 48-canonical-base / 192-episode development cohort; descriptive development evidence only, not independent ARC generalization confirmation.

independent_non_gold_sentinel.rule: No replacement cohort may be generated or opened during this protocol. Absence prevents an independent-generalization claim but does not alter the development-cohort estimand.

cohorts.training: E04-C frozen TRAIN-only paired schedule; validation rows were not read.

bootstrap.unit: canonical base, resampling all four turns together

primary.estimand: treatment minus control exact-grid accuracy on FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL, paired by canonical base across four turns
primary.improved: point estimate >= 0.0416666667 and bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
primary.inconclusive: valid result not meeting IMPROVED and not meeting a protection failure

protected_outcomes.marker_binding_control: treatment minus V7 exact-grid accuracy; a decline of more than 8/192 is a protection failure
protected_outcomes.no_transform_retention_control: treatment minus V7 exact-grid accuracy; a decline of more than 8/192 is a protection failure
protected_outcomes.rotation_target_transfer: treatment minus V7 exact-grid accuracy; descriptive transfer only unless the primary rule is IMPROVED

stop.on_improved: SUBMIT_RESULT_TO_DIRECTOR; no follow-on training is authorized by this protocol
